none: PAS NLM-CBDF34: Roman Coin: Radiate fraction, commemorative issue for Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate fraction, probably commemorative issue of 270 for Claudius II, Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust left. Obverse inscription: [DIV]O C[LAVDIO]. Reverse description: Altar. Reverse inscription: [C]ONSE[CRATIO]. Diameter (in excess of): 15.3mm, Weight: 1.14gms, die axis: probably 6
